answer_1.quote: Large language models have demonstrated remarkable performance in various downstream tasks by scaling in both parameters and training data, thereby capturing extensive world knowledge during pretraining.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs involve updated model responses to knowledge editing queries, such as correcting factual statements (e.g., updating presidential knowledge) and answering context-free questions or completing counterfactual sentences.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate all methods from three perspectives based on the EasyEdit, as defined in §2.1: Reliability (Rel.), Generality (Gen.), and Locality (Loc.), which are commonly used in prior works.
